services.desc: Welcome to the Troy University Police website. All of us here at the Troy University Police Department hope that the introduction of our website is useful and informative. The men and women that are a part of the Troy University Police Department are committed to the highest quality of protection of life and property. This can be upheld through our philosophy of Community Policing. Community Policing involves being a part of the community by addressing the public's problems and working to resolve and solve them. The Troy University Police is wholly dedicated in the maintenance and promotion of individual rights and human dignity. Parking and traffic regulations established in this brochure
